newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bridgestone up on global issue buying interest.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone up on global issue buying interest.

text.p: Bridgestone Corp shares were up on Thursday morning as investors actively sought shares of laggard, global, blue-chip issues, brokers said.
As of 0125 GMT the shares were up 30 yen at 2,100 yen in trade of 3.751 million shares, the third most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

"Automobile issues have been receiving attention and it is rubbing off on Bridgestone," a broker at a "big-four" brokerage said. "About a month has passed since it renewed its record high and the shares are ready to be bought again."
Honda Motor Co Ltd shares were up 80 yen at 3,250 yen. Nissan Motor Co Ltd rose five yen to 677 yen.
